description:
Fall Back Asleep | Soft Bansuri | 3 Hours

Woke up at 3am? Stay still. Let the flute carry you back down.

Soft bansuri flute music to fall back asleep: deep, slow Raga Malkauns phrases with long quiet spaces, for nights when you wake and your mind starts talking. 3 hours, no drums, no sudden sounds.

▶ Keep going - the full Meditation playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199nvhUBCx5L9ROrDP44H4JzN

Perfect for falling back asleep after waking at night, insomnia, light sleepers, deep sleep, quiet night rest.

Instrument: Bansuri and tanpura drone
Raga: Malkauns
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
